name: Honda VF750F / VF1000F Interceptor
engine: 748 or 998 cc liquid-cooled V4, chain-driven cams, four carbs
intro: The first V4 Interceptors. Fast for their day, with chain-driven cams that are known to wear.

add.title: Check for cam and rocker wear
add.instructions: With the valve covers off, look at the cam lobes and rocker pads for pitting or flat spots. Early Honda V4s are known for cam wear, often from poor oiling or old oil.
add.reason: Worn cams on early V4 Interceptors are a known weak point.

G: Rebuild one carb at a time and keep each one's parts apart.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
